import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int P1 = 998244353;
    static final int P2 = 1000000007;
    static final int half = 1000000;
    static final int[] pow10 = {1, 10, 100, 1000, 10000, 100000, 1000000, 10000000, 100000000};

    static long answer = 0;
    static long total2 = 0;
    static long total1 = 0;
    static long number = 0;
    static long[] s = new long[10];
    static List<Integer>[] vec = new ArrayList[10];

    static {
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            vec[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
    }

    static long mod(long x, int P) {
        x %= P;
        if (x < 0) x += P;
        return x;
    }

    static boolean check_condition(long x) {
        return x * half + half - 1 <= number && x * half * 10 > number;
    }

    static void initialize(int depth, int val) {
        if (depth > 6) return;
        vec[depth].add((int) mod(total1 - val, P1));
        s[depth] += mod(total1 - val, P1);
        for (int digit = 0; digit < 10; digit++) {
            initialize(depth + 1, val * 10 + digit);
        }
    }

    static void process(int depth, long v) {
        if (v > number) return;
        if (check_condition(v)) {
            for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
                long t = mod(total2 + 1 - v * pow10[i], P1);
                int pos = lowerBound(vec[i], (int)(P1 - t));
                answer = mod(answer + s[i] + t * vec[i].size() - (long) P1 * (vec[i].size() - pos), P2);
            }
            total2 += total1;
        } else {
            answer = mod(answer + mod(++total2 - v, P1), P2);
            for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                process(depth + 1, v * 10 + i);
            }
        }
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Integer> list, int value) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= value) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String line = br.readLine();
        number = Long.parseLong(line.trim());
        initialize(0, 0);
        for (int i = 0; i <= 6; i++) {
            Collections.sort(vec[i]);
        }
        total2 = -1;
        process(0, 0);
        System.out.println(answer);
    }
}
